design.prompt: A woman in her mid-thirties with a warm, low-mid, slightly husky voice. Intelligent and quietly confident, like an architecture critic telling a friend a story she finds fascinating. Clear, softly British, internationally neutral diction. Calm, unhurried pace with natural pauses; a hint of dry wit on ironic lines; never theatrical, never salesy, no announcer tone.

openai.instructions: Warm, intelligent documentary narrator. Measured pace, clear diction, a hint of dry wit.
